scope: TLS handshake policy and client certificate-chain validation for case-owned kind kube-apiserver client-facing loopback endpoints. A default Kubernetes profile is compared with a TLS 1.3 minimum-version profile; a separate TLS 1.2 reference profile evaluates a configured cipher allow-list. No application request or non-loopback host is contacted. Outbound kube-apiserver connections, service-specific TLS paths, and managed-provider controls are outside this case. The owned default cluster also verifies the API server kubelet and etcd trust routes and restoration.
